description: Proposed first floor rear extension, AC units to rear facade, internal alterations and all associated works at 120 Elgin Avenue, HA3 8QJ
decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents:&nbsp;<span style="line-height: normal;">Planning Statement; Reasonable Exception Statement; Location Plan; Noise Assessment Report; Product data sheet for FDTC60VH/SRC60ZSX-W1; B285569-3000 Rev A; B285569-1100 Rev A; B285569-3100 Rev A; Product data sheet for SCHM80ZS-W.</span>

Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that order with or without modification), no window(s)/door(s) shall be installed in the flank elevation(s) of the development hereby permitted without the prior permission in writing of the local planning authority.
The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

<p>The rating level of the noise emitted from the site shall be at least 10dB below the existing background noise level. The noise levels shall be determined at the boundary of the nearest noise sensitive premises. The measurements and assessment shall be made in accordance to the latest British Standard 4142 and BS8233</p>
